attempts.summary: Built a site-to-site IPsec (IKEv2/PSK, tunnel mode) VPN between node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.10.10.0/30), carrying node3's private LAN (192.168.10.0/24) and node4's private LAN (192.168.20.0/24) encrypted end-to-end. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, with only ESP visible on the transit wire. All four nodes were subsequently restarted one at a time via native reboot mechanisms, with boot-identity changes confirmed and full recovery verified after each.
